capabilities: Manage tasks on a Kanban board backed by a single Markdown note
Drag and drop tasks and columns, collapse columns, and show task counts
Define custom priorities with your own names, symbols, and colors
Set deadlines that optionally raise a task's priority as they approach
Create recurring tasks and archive finished ones
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; until then it must be installed via BRAT or built from source (Node.js 20+, manual copy of main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Interface is available in English, Russian, German, French and Spanish.
motivation: The author wanted a simple task tracker with the widest possible customization, where almost every feature can be tuned or turned off.
problem: Obsidian has no board view for Markdown task lists, so managing tasks across stages means editing plain lists by hand.

relations.evidence: you can install it with the BRAT plugin, including on mobile

summary: Kanban task board stored in a single Markdown note, with custom columns, priorities, deadlines, recurring tasks and an archive.
